entities.name: The Traveler
entities.description: The player-created human planeswalker of the Magic: Legends game, whose spark's cause is unknown.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who became the new planeswalker's mentor and guided them in the Meditation Realm.

entities.name: Vaash Vroga
entities.description: A figure the Traveler is helping Ral track, who duped Thada Adel and takes part in schemes across planes.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A wary planeswalker on Zendikar who helps the Outsider.

entities.name: Huntmaster Procyon
entities.description: A Zendikari hunter who works with the Outsider to uncover the hedron corruption.

entities.name: Kama
entities.description: A merfolk scholar who asks the Outsider's aid.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: A merfolk leader who sent water elementals and whose authority was weakened by Thada Adel.

entities.name: Thada Adel
entities.description: A merfolk leader duped by Vaash into thinking she could heal Tazeem by restarting the Roil.

entities.name: Nani Oula
entities.description: A witch of Gavony who takes the Traveler as an apprentice and is later trapped in an amulet.

entities.name: Kurjak
entities.description: The high shaman of Crussebourg killed by the Traveler, later freed to help trap Nani.

entities.name: Volker
entities.description: A rival witch who reveals Nani's deceptions and plots against her.

entities.name: Gisa Cecani
entities.description: A necromancer who asks the Traveler to destroy Geralf's lab.

entities.name: Geralf
entities.description: A necromancer whose lab the Traveler is sent to destroy.

entities.name: Volomir
entities.description: A wraith who tells his tale and warns of Nani's abusive power.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: A goblin whom the planeswalker helps in Shiv.

entities.name: King Omek
entities.description: A goblin king in Shiv who relinquishes the throne in fear.

entities.name: Adeliz
entities.description: A figure who asks the Hero to prove Darigaaz's innocence.

entities.name: Darigaaz
entities.description: A dragon framed in Shiv, freed by the Hero.

entities.name: Kyashatar
entities.description: A dragon broodmother and councilmember assassinated by the Hero and later reanimated as a revenant.

entities.name: Gavon Deniz
entities.description: A Benalish figure who armed Omek's goblins and activated the Mana Rig; slain by the Hero.

entities.name: Josu Vess
entities.description: A necromancer acting in Belzenlok's name who reanimates Kyashatar.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: The demon in whose name Josu Vess acts.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where the Outsider helps stop the hedron grid corruption.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where the Traveler becomes Nani's apprentice.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: The Dominarian region where the Traveler earns the title Hero of Old Onkoom.

entities.name: Meditation Realm
entities.description: The place where the new planeswalker sparks and Ral studies a pocket realm connected to them.

events.summary: The new planeswalker sparks to the Meditation Realm, startling Ral Zarek and letting Vaash Vroga escape.
events.quote: Upon sparking to the Meditation Realm , the new planeswalker startled Ral Zarek who was nearby, allowing Vaash Vroga to catch him off-guard and escape.

events.summary: Ral becomes the planeswalker's mentor in exchange for help tracking Vaash.
events.quote: Ral took on the role of mentor and showed the planeswalker how to follow in Vaash's wake.

events.summary: The Outsider arrives on Zendikar's Tazeem and Nissa warms up when told Ral sent them.
events.quote: The Outsider arrived on Zendikar in the continent of Tazeem , where a wary Nissa warmed up once the Outsider mentioned Ral had sent them.

events.summary: Procyon and the Outsider discover the merfolk are corrupting the hedron grid.
events.quote: Procyon and the Outsider discovered that the merfolk were corrupting the entire hedron grid using water elementals, causing the wildlife and locals to become unnaturally aggressive.

events.summary: Noyan Dar explains that Vaash duped Thada Adel into trying to restart the Roil.
events.quote: He explained that Vaash had duped Thada Adel into thinking she could heal Tazeem by restarting the Roil .

events.summary: Nissa and the Outsider confront Thada Adel and destroy the machine.
events.quote: Nissa and the Outsider then confronted Thada and destroyed the machine.

events.summary: The planeswalker activates the pocket realm's aetheric core, confirming Ral's suspicion.
events.quote: Ral's suspicion was confirmed when the planeswalker activated the pocket realm's aetheric core simply by mentally focusing on it.

events.summary: On Innistrad the Traveler saves Ulav and Havish from wolves, leading to apprenticeship under Nani Oula.
events.quote: Upon arriving in Hexenrast on Innistrad , the Traveler saved the apprentice Ulav and the elder Havish from some wolves.

events.summary: The Traveler massacres Crussebourg residents, including Kurjak, earning the title Butcher of Crussebourg.
events.quote: this massacre earned the Traveler the title Butcher of Crussebourg .

events.summary: Kurjak's soul helps trap Nani's soul in the amulet.
events.quote: Kurjak then conducted a ritual that allowed his Butcher to trap Nani's soul within the amulet.

events.summary: The planeswalker and Squee infiltrate Omek's fortress and kill the pretender Kedu; Omek abdicates.
events.quote: Together, they infiltrated Omek's fortress, killed the pretender to the throne, Kedu, and defeated Omek's soldiers.

events.summary: The Hero rids Old Onkoom of goblins and earns the title Hero of Old Onkoom.
events.quote: The hero's victory earned them the title Hero of Old Onkoom .

events.summary: The Hero assassinates Kyashatar and frees Darigaaz.
events.quote: Within Kyashatar's lair, the Hero assassinated the dragon broodmother and councilmember.

events.summary: The Hero slays Gavon Deniz and deactivates the Mana Rig.
events.quote: The Hero dueled and slew Deniz, then deactivated the Rig.

events.summary: Josu Vess has Kyashatar reanimated, and the Traveler slays the revenant.
events.quote: The Traveler then slew the reanimated Kyashatar, and Darigaaz saw to his proper burial.

relations.quote: Ral took on the role of mentor and showed the planeswalker how to follow in Vaash's wake.

relations.note: She took the Traveler in as an apprentice in dark arts.
relations.quote: Nani took the Traveler in as an apprentice to her dark arts and began tasking the Traveler with all manner of foul deeds.
The Hero dueled and slew Deniz, then deactivated the Rig.
The Traveler then slew the reanimated Kyashatar, and Darigaaz saw to his proper burial.
Josu Vess , in the name of Belzenlok , had his followers reanimate Kyashatar as a revenant .
He explained that Vaash had duped Thada Adel into thinking she could heal Tazeem by restarting the Roil .
